Click a message to read it. The ESC consent form, VEEC assignment form and Activity Guide versions are listed at the end of the register.
Nothing sends until its switch is on
SwitchWhat it controls
Auto quote sendReady Check quotes go to the owner when the Mitti form is Complete and every check passesOn
Automatic installer offersOffer goes to one installer covering the postcode (fewest active jobs, then nearest); 24h each; after 2 misses \u2192 Needs meOff
Automatic electrician offersInstaller\u2019s usual electrician, else the nearest approved REC covering the postcode; same 24h ruleOff
Customer emailsEvery owner emailOff
Customer textsEvery owner textOff
Spot saved confirmationEmail and text when a spot is savedOff
We couldn\u2019t get in todayEmail and text after a no-access install dayOff
Rebate form remindersDays 1, 3 and 7 after the installOff
ESC consent copyEmail after the AP signsOn
Installer textsGood morning texts, offers and remindersOn
Mitti pick-upForms started in Mitti become jobsOn
ESC notice robotSubmits install notifications to the Registry itselfOff
Switch on one type at a time. Turning one on asks whether to send or cancel what is held for it.Cancel all held \u00b7 212
What the portal does on its own
RuleWhat happens
Save my spot and estimatesReminders on days 2, 7 and 21, then the lead closes itself
Installer offer24 hours to answer, then it lapses and Needs me says Choose again
Automatic installer offersWhen switched on: one installer covering the postcode (fewest active jobs, then nearest), 24 hours each; after 2 misses the job goes to Needs me
Automatic electrician offersWhen switched on: the installer\u2019s usual electrician, else the nearest approved REC covering the postcode; same 24-hour rule
Install daysInstaller offers 3 days after the PIESA; owner takes one or suggests 1\u20135; one office alert at 10 days left
Deposit holdInstall day is provisional for 48 hours until the 10% deposit is in
Rebate formOwner asked at completion, reminded days 1, 3, 7; office alert on day 10
Privacy noticePer person, reminders days 3 and 7; can\u2019t be on an install until acknowledged
30-day PIESA windowReminders at 20 and 10 days; a repeat PIESA is paid by whoever caused the delay
The three Mitti forms the portal reads
FormWhat the portal readsLast synced
Ready CheckAreas and m\u00b2, existing insulation, product, hazards, electrician, Portal Job NumberToday 9:35amOpen in Mitti \u203a
PIESAHazards and actions, fixes items, electrician sign-offYesterday 4:10pmOpen in Mitti \u203a
Install dayPre-start checks, SWMS, photos and videos per zone, lock-out, product per zone, CompleteToday 6:40amOpen in Mitti \u203a
Forms started in Mitti become jobs every 15 minutes (switch under Switches); ones that can\u2019t be matched wait on Jobs \u203a Ready Checks started in Mitti.

PIESA donePIESA \u00b7 electrician and date
Product and R-valueReady Check \u00b7 product per area
AP representativeJo Mitchell
